head_commit.message:
Switch AGENTS contextual wrapper to XML-like opening/closing tags

Render AGENTS contextual-user fragments as:
<AGENTS.md INSTRUCTIONS FOR {directory}>\n{contents}\n</AGENTS.md INSTRUCTIONS FOR {directory}>

Because the directory appears in both tags, add dedicated AGENTS fragment detection in model-visible-context instead of relying on static start/end marker matching.

Update context parsing and test expectations that previously keyed on the legacy # AGENTS.md ... <INSTRUCTIONS> wrapper format.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
